name: Notes
description: Important project context shared across chats: decisions, constraints, dependencies, blockers and links. You and Claude keep it current.

tools.description: Read the calling chat's project notes, shared with every chat in that project, with ids. They also arrive with each message. Open dependencies constrain only their described work.

Save important knowledge ABOUT THE PROJECT that remains useful to other chats beyond this task: lasting decisions, constraints, facts, project links, dependencies or blockers. Example wait: pipeline improvements deferred until the Jenkins-to-Azure-DevOps migration is complete. Not a to-do list, task reminder, progress log or handoff. Never save current work, routine next steps, temporary branches, changed files or commits. Keep notes concise; read first and update duplicates instead.

kind.description: wait: project dependency/blocker; note: lasting project knowledge; link: project reference

text.description: Concise project context, useful beyond this task or chat

tools.description: Update a project note by id when project facts change, or mark a dependency confirmed cleared (done: true). Update rather than duplicate. These notes are shared across the project's chats.

id.description: The note's id, as the list shows it

tools.description: Remove obsolete project knowledge by id from the shared project notes.
